title: Basin Ledger: a basin's water balanced day by day across coupled models (SWAT+, NextGen, MODFLOW 6 and water users) through BMI
description:
Basin Ledger couples a watershed model, a groundwater model and the models of large water users through the Basic Model Interface and steps them together one day at a time with one Python driver: SWAT+ through swatplus-bmi, MODFLOW 6 through its own BMI/XMI (libmf6, modflowapi), finished NextGen (NGIAB) runs replayed day by day, and water users as BMI components from waterledger-models. It routes users' water through wells, surface intakes, point sources and utility chains, applies feedback rules (curtailment, dry mode, drawdown limits), couples stream-aquifer exchange both ways, and restarts exactly from a saved day. Every volume that moves between models is entered in a ledger as sent and as received, and a day where they differ stops the run. Places are examples: a synthetic example for the tests and Plaster Creek, Michigan, on a calibrated NextGen model.

Designed and directed by Andrew Sommerlot; written with an AI coding assistant (Claude, by Anthropic).
